reviews.author: Lloyd Howes
reviews.text: Had called five places for some work on my Mini Cooper S. No one would touch. I stumbled upon Jamie’s shop and called. Travis was very helpful getting my call on the schedule swiftly and Jamie returned car on time. I have used him for oil change brakes a check on a radiator hose connection needed a cam for engine and now my car is safe to return to New Hampshire.....very good place the people are friendly and thanks to Nate was able to get to and from Cross Hill to them!!! Thxs guys!!!
